title: Transparency reduces computational load and enables the representation of facts

statements.text: Transparency is an advantage for a system with limited time and neural resources, since it amounts to missing information about its own processing. Naive realism keeps the system from losing contact with the world in introspection of its own mechanisms, and a transparent world-model lets it treat information as factual.
